entries.wording: Label has been generated for shipping
entries.note: State packageCreated: the sender printed the label, before Islandwide has the parcel.
State packagePickedUp. The page follows the wording with the sender's address, which the adapter leaves out.
State packageLogicalPickedUp, which the page heads with the same Picked up image as a pickup.
State inTerminal: a scan at one of Islandwide's terminals, which the row names.
State outOfTerminal: the parcel left the terminal the row names.
State preOutForDelivery, which the page heads with its In transit image.
State dPInTerminal, which the page heads with its In transit image.
State deliveredToExternalCarrier, a hand-over to another carrier, which the page heads with its In transit image.
State outForDelivery; the row names the terminal the round leaves from.
State delivered. The page follows it with the delivery address and the signer's name, which the adapter leaves out.
State dPDeliveryDropOff, the caption of the page's image for it: the parcel waits at a drop-off and pickup center.
State hold, the caption of the page's image for it.
State exception, the caption of the page's image for it.
State packageUnavailableAtPickup, the caption of the page's image for it: the courier found no parcel to collect.
State canceled, the caption of the page's image for it.
State misreturned, the caption of the page's image for it.
State misdelivered, the caption of the page's image for it.
State deactivated, the caption of the page's image for it.
State additionalDocumentationRequired, the caption of the page's image for it.
State packageDamage, the caption of the page's image for it.
